tagline: The world leader in ecological transformation
hero_kpi_rationale: Water technologies, hazardous waste, and bioenergy are growing 2 to 3 times faster than the rest of the group, validating the GreenUp strategy and positioning Veolia as the leader in ecological transformation.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The margin between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved in 2024 driven by better operational efficiency and contract repricing.
kpis.signal: Gross margin expanding despite inflationary environment.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving through budgetary discipline and internal GreenUp transformation.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in research and innovation divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Veolia is increasing innovation investments across ten research centers, eight innovation hubs, and venture capital partnerships, notably in decarbonization, circularity, and emerging pollutant removal.
kpis.signal: Targeted increase in R&D spending on green technologies and open innovation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Annual spending to maintain and expand physical assets in water, waste, and energy.
kpis.description: Investments remain strong to enhance capacity in water, waste, and energy, supporting growth in key GreenUp strategy segments.
kpis.signal: Stable and sustained Capex oriented toward essential infrastructure modernization.

kpis.name: Total Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across the Veolia group.
kpis.description: The group maintains discipline on headcount while pursuing GreenUp transformation and strengthening employee engagement through the Veolia Cares program.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction despite growth, reflecting productivity and efficiency gains...

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Dividends per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of 1.5 EUR last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders through dividends of 1.28 billion EUR last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 105.2% last year.

risks.title: Operational risks related to cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report in the section on negative impacts. Moderate intensity language ('Cost of remediating'). Stable, non-new risk. Cybersecurity category: strong weighting in current regulatory context.

risks.title: Risks to continuity of essential services
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position, section 'Safe and resilient essential services'. Strong language ('Continuity and quality of essential services'). Stable but structural risk. High weighting as essential services: major operational criticality.

risks.title: Reputational risks in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position, section 'Responsible management'. Moderate-strong intensity language ('Reputational risk in the event of serious incidents'). Stable risk. High weighting as reputation: direct financial impact on contracts.

risks.title: Risks of high personnel turnover
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position, section 'Attraction, retention and development'. Moderate language ('Risk of high turnover which could lead to difficulties'). Stable risk. Medium weighting as impact is indirect on execution capacity for complex projects.

risks.title: Risks of stakeholder challenges
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position, section 'Stakeholders engagement'. Moderate language ('Risk of challenge and dispute'). Stable risk. Medium weighting as depends on stakeholder perception of activities.

risks.title: Risks of discrimination and workplace harassment
risks.score_rationale: Risk in final position, section 'Responsible social policy'. Moderate language ('Potential exposure of employees'). Stable risk. Medium weighting as social/regulatory risk typical but with significant HR impact.

risks.title: Risks of increased regulatory costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central position, decarbonization section. Moderate language ('Additional costs resulting from increased regulatory requirements'). Stable risk. Medium weighting as direct financial impact but predictable in regulatory context.

ai_positioning.summary: Veolia adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, progressively integrating it into operations to optimize resource management and predictive maintenance, without making it a major strategic lever.
evidence: Mention of digital innovation in water and energy network management
Use of advanced digital solutions for operational efficiency
No direct reference to generative AI or large language models in documents
